newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MERALCO B SHEDS 7 PCT IN MIDTRADE.
newsitem.headline: MERALCO B SHEDS 7 PCT IN MIDTRADE.

text.p: Philipine electricity distributor Manila Electric Corp (Meralco) B shares fell 10 pesos, or 7.09 percent, to 131 pesos at midsession on Monday due to a technical correction, brokers said.
"It rallied one or two days last week, went down one day and surged even higher the next. This looks like a correction," said Juanis Barredo, analyst at Citisecurities Inc.
Meralco B shares were among the most actively traded in midsession.
"It has reached a good price and people are just selling," said Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities.
Ong said the issue had been rising last week on news the government was selling its shares in Meralco at a premium over the market price.
Meralco A shares, available to local investors only, fell 2.50 pesos to 86.50 pesos.
